creation_reason.reason: Three prior frozen large-cap tests cleared or failed on the drawdown / tradeability axis (full-main-board no_alpha; large-cap pure-quality falsified; cash_conversion a statistical alpha clue that failed the relative-NAV drawdown gate). External A-share low-risk-anomaly literature reports a volatility-driven, behaviorally-grounded low-risk premium that stays strong in the largest, most liquid names with low turnover, so low_volatility is a pre-committed new hypothesis tested on a new singleton ledger. It is externally motivated, not derived from an in-sample diagnostic of a prior run, and not a rescue of any prior result; it is tested on a single 2018-2025 historical period and the vs-CSI300 evidence is single-period.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first reviewed A-long large-cap low_volatility primary-cell signal-search execution spends one planned test regardless of falsified, statistical-alpha-clue, or tradeable-candidate result.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: If the future primary cell fails or is diagnostic-only, do not rerun with changed factor definition, trailing window, volatility estimator, universe N, market-cap field, neutralization, holding period, benchmark, top fraction, cost model, statistical threshold, sub-period rule, or risk-gate threshold without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.

planned_tests.design_summary: One frozen primary cell: low_volatility (negative trailing 252-trading-day realized volatility of daily adj_factor total returns), percentile-ranked, marginal 0.5 industry + 0.5 size neutralization, 504d hold versus CSI300, top-500 PIT circ_mv universe with the reviewed 000043 exclusion. Two-tier verdict: statistical-alpha-clue gates (positive mean net excess, HAC t >= 2.0, >= 48 monthly cohorts, both median sub-period halves positive, concentration guards) then the rolling-overlapping relative-NAV drawdown >= -15% gate for the tradeable-candidate label. Startup months without a sufficient trailing volatility window are excluded from cohort formation. Reuses the vetted measurement chain and the reviewed full-main-board daily close series; fetches nothing.
